sections.text_helper: Section 32.4.24 "End of conversion sequence (EOS, JEOS)" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1493.
sections.section_content:
The ADC notifies the application at the end of each regular sequence (EOS) and injected
sequence (JEOS) event.
The ADC sets the EOS flag as soon as the conversion of the last data of the regular
sequence is complete. An interrupt can be generated if the EOSIE bit is set. The EOS flag is
cleared by the software by programming it to 1.
The ADC sets the JEOS flag as soon as the conversion of the last data of the injected
sequence is complete. An interrupt can be generated if the JEOSIE bit is set. The JEOS flag
is cleared by the software by programming it to 1.
